name: Lionel

attributes.attribute: a minor knight of the Round Table

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lionel is a minor knight of the Round Table. The source marks him as the cousin of the remarkable Lancelot. Of Lionel himself little separate story survives. He stands as one of the many lesser figures the court keeps beside its great champion. The record places him in the Arthurian company rather than at the center of any tale.

okr.objective: Place Lionel correctly in the list of Arthurian knights.
key_results: Call Lionel a minor knight of the Round Table.
Mark the small amount of separate story that survives.
